name: Notubiz decisions to decidesk Decisions
description: Reads besluiten/moties for an event from the Notubiz public RIS source and writes them into decidesk's Decision OpenRegister objects (decisionType=motion). {{event_id}} is supplied per run; targetId is decidesk's register/schema id pair (fill in per instance: <decideskRegisterId>/<decisionSchemaId>).
